definitions.explanation: Having the ability to endure hardship, pain, or difficulty without complaining.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{我慢強|がまんづよ}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{我慢強|がまんづよ}く⟦{待|ま}っていたら→待つ：00469_matsu⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: By waiting patiently, my chance finally came.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{我慢強|がまんづよ}く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't do this job unless you're patient.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧ (patience/endurance) + ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strong)
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - not patient (negative)
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}くて - patient and... (te-form)
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}かった - was patient (past)
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}く + verb - patiently (adverb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}く⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ - to wait patiently
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}く⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ - to work on persistently
- {我慢強|がまんづよ}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ - patient personality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}い→粘り強い：07165_nebarizuyoi⟧ - tenacious, persistent
- ⟦{辛抱強|しんぼうづよ}い→辛抱強い：18963_shinbouzuyoi⟧ - patient, forbearing
- ⟦{根気強|こんきづよ}い→根気強い：21760_konkizuyoi⟧ - persevering

USAGE:
{我慢強|がまんづよ}い emphasizes enduring hardship; ⟦{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}い→粘り強い：07165_nebarizuyoi⟧ emphasizes not giving up.
